To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The conceptual framework for supervision of teacher development is a useful tool for educators to identify the tensions that exist in the supervision of teacher development and to guide them in the development of reflective practice.

1) the conceptual and procedural tensions within instructional leadership can be located along a continuum; 2) instructional leadership for teacher growth and development can be located in a dynamic, multi-dimensional space; 3) the questions identified in the framework can be used to locate instructional leadership for teacher supervision; and 4) the framework is a useful tool for analyzing instructional leadership and locating supervision.

The conceptual and procedural foci for supervision can be viewed as a continuum that is not necessarily mutually exclusive and that supervision can be viewed in terms of the procedural and conceptual dimensions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the tensions between procedural and conceptual foci within the supervision of teacher development.
the development of reflective supervision, a framework for analyzing the procedural and conceptual dimensions of supervision and the tensions that exist within the two dimensions of supervision.
how teachers can become more reflective in their teaching practices, and how they can become better equipped to guide their own professional development.

the framework provides a tool for teachers and leaders to use in order to become more reflective and self-directed.

we must be able to locate our supervision and professional development in a way that is meaningful to the teacher and the school.
